data.description: Raster images: max 8 MiB. UTF-8 SVG: max 1 MiB, restricted safe profile checked by runtime validator.

name.description: Optional display title; empty uses a content-based label.

fillColor.description: Shape fill. Missing uses legacy color; none is transparent.

video.description: Omitted: default videoSettings object for type video, null for other types. Explicit null allowed for all types; objects validated even on other types.

bubble.description: Omitted: default bubble object for type bubble; null otherwise. Type bubble requires a non-null object. Objects on other types are preserved but not rendered.

until.description: Scene-local exclusive end; must be > at and <= scene duration. Null/omitted: scene end, retaining legacy final paused-frame behavior.

exitAnimation.description: Particle variants require type text, image or shape at runtime; fragments retain the original colors.

crop.description: Applied only on image elements, before contain/cover fitting.

space.description: Scene follows the camera; screen stays in the viewport. All members of a flat group must use the same space (runtime constraint). Null is rejected.

lighting.description: Multiplicative 2D spotlight plus an alpha-shaped cast shadow. All element types, not groups. Sampled element-local clock. Strength 0 bypasses exactly. Not 3D lighting or inter-element shadow casting.

kaleidoscope.description: Alternating mirrored source sectors, clipped to the element box. All element types, not groups. Source rotation uses sampled element-local time; speed 0 freezes rotation. Transparency and gaps are retained.

print.description: Luminance-based dot or line screen, all element types, not groups. Preserves source alpha. Project-pixel spacing. Strength 0 bypasses exactly.

glitch.description: Seeded horizontal band displacement and RGB splitting. All element types, not groups. Rate 0 freezes. Both displacements 0 bypass the filter exactly. No opacity flashing.

reveal.description: Element-local mask reveal on all element types, not groups. Uses sampled stop-motion time. Completed/disabled masks do not clip; does not extend visibility.

afterimages.description: Historical poses behind text/image/shape elements, oldest first. No recursive trails. End with the element/scene. Optional flat-alpha tint; normal compositing for ghosts.

stopMotion.description: Element-local sample-and-hold animation. Does not retime camera/group motion, video footage, audio or exact visibility boundaries. Optional seeded position/rotation jitter.

paper.description: Code-native collage paper, supported on text/image/shape when enabled. Border is inside element bounds; original content is scaled down. Unknown fields/null rejected; omitted fields use defaults.

exposure.description: Double exposure with lower layers/background in this scene. Omitted: disabled defaults. Contribution multiplies existing element opacity; 0 hides the enabled exposure, 1 uses full opacity. No automatic silhouette masking.

liquid.description: Omitted: disabled defaults. Element-local timeline-driven liquid distortion; not a group setting.

backgroundEnabled.description: False hides the entire scene background (color, gradient, image) without changing its saved settings or hiding elements.

videos.description: Video namespace; omitted/null normalize to an empty map at runtime. Author with an object.

description.description: Plain text video description; not rendered in scenes.

firstComment.description: Suggested first comment for publication; plain text with optional line breaks, not rendered in scenes.

hashtags.description: Comma-separated list, e.g. #SceneScript, #Video. Not an array.

data.description: PNG, JPEG or WebP base64 data URL; runtime maximum 8 MiB.

thumbnail.description: Independent embedded publication cover image, not a scene element or image asset reference.

data.description: Runtime: nonempty base64, max 32 MiB; no playlists; browser must decode.

title: SceneScript 1.0
$comment: Runtime validation additionally enforces unique IDs, resolved asset references, element.at <= scene.duration, total UTF-8 file size and image decoding / dimensions. Do not include $schema in project data. Comic cross-references, until relative to at/scene duration, safe geometry and text overflow are runtime checks, not structural schema constraints.

stops.description: Ascending positions; equal positions create hard edges.

asset.description: Empty or a key in root videos, not root assets; runtime resolves references.

end.description: Null uses file duration; explicit end must exceed start and not exceed referenced duration (runtime checks).

motionPath.description: Relative stage-percentage offsets. Runtime also checks start <= containing scene duration.

instructions.description: Delivery direction for external speech generation; not spoken or rendered.

speaker.description: Speaker or voice label for external speech generation; not a provider voice ID.

narration.description: Narration or a text-only speech draft (asset empty). Matched speech import resets trims and extends scene/project duration to fit real decoded audio. Runtime checks reference, start/end and scope; legacy playback still clips to scope.

tail.description: Anchor mode requires an existing element and named anchor in the same scene. Manual target is a local bubble percentage, independent of speaker visibility.

placement.description: Static affine placement, applied before the group transform. Runtime additionally rejects singular matrices.

name.description: Optional display title; empty uses a content-based label.

until.description: Scene-local exclusive end; must be > at and <= scene duration. Null/omitted: scene end, retaining legacy final paused-frame behavior.

crop.description: Intrinsic image percentages; runtime additionally requires x+width <=100 and y+height <=100.

camera.$comment: Runtime additionally requires first at=0, strictly ordered arrivals after previous holds, scene duration bounds and x+width/y+width<=100.
